description: One financial field for a Taiwan company, newest period first. Taiwan's own open data. History is shallow: it starts in 2026, when Belfort began archiving the source. Income figures are cumulative from 1 January (basis year_to_date). Discrete quarters use basis quarter_derived. One page via limit/cursor. Costs 1 credit. A figure can be withheld (null/absent beats a guess) and can change or disappear when a later filing arrives. Figures follow the source, including any adjustments described with the figure. This is filing data, not investment advice.

basis.description: Filter by the basis of the figure.

cursor.description: The meta.next_cursor of the previous page.

id.description: A 4-digit stock code (2330) or an 8-digit unified business number.

name: get_tw_financials
title: Get Taiwan financials
